The long train is still passing at the end, for the next shot to continue its departure. Riley stays planted on the platform, shoulders drop in disappointment, and she turns toward camera just as in the source. Her position does not travel with the train.

A single uninterrupted shot, no cut, pan or camera shake. Preserve station architecture and platform lines. No reversing train, no stationary closed-door hold, no bending carriage, no sliding Riley or moving platform, no new characters or wardrobe changes. Preserve natural human face and anatomy.
